text: The authors report that an untrained GPT-4-Turbo judge agreed with the consultant 72% of the time even before consultancy training, making it exploitable by one-sided consultants. They fine-tune GPT-4-Turbo on human judgments of debate and consultancy transcripts from Michael et al. (2023) and Khan et al. (2024), and obtain the most calibrated results from the token-level probabilities of each debater's name.
title: Calibrated judge: GPT-4-Turbo fine-tuned on human debate and consultancy judgments
